# Credits

This project stands on the CS2 server plugin ecosystem rather than replacing it.

- [CounterStrikeSharp](https://github.com/roflmuffin/CounterStrikeSharp) provides the C# plugin runtime used by this project.
- [CS2-Bot-Hider](https://github.com/XBribo/CS2-Bot-Hider) is related work for bot persona, SteamID, and avatar disguise. This project can optionally use its public capability at runtime, but does not vendor its code.
- [CS2-Bot-Improver](https://github.com/ed0ard/CS2-Bot-Improver) is related work for better CS2 bot behavior and personalities. This project does not vendor its code.
- [DeepSeek API](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/) is the default OpenAI-compatible endpoint example.
